I’m so increasingly thankful for them all but they’re starting to get on my nerves. Since I’m studying to be a nurse, I can understand and break down medical jargon to my family in a way that they can understand. This is not a reasonable expectation, and it's not fair to put you in this position. Remember, it's okay to say no and set boundaries. Your family should respect your limitations and encourage you to focus on your studies and becoming a qualified nurse.
